title: Count Up
reference: repeat 3 { tally_up repeat tally { forward } turn_left }
hints: Each stretch of quay is one tile longer than the last: 1, then 2, then 3.
Add 1 to the tally, walk tally tiles, turn left. Do that three times.
repeat 3 { tally_up repeat tally { forward } turn_left }

story.intro: PATCH: "Dockyard. VANTA got into the Wavehouse and scrambled every cargo manifest. See the tally board? It holds one number, and you can count it up."
story.outro: PATCH: "One, two, three. You never wrote a single number in your program. The tally did the counting."
